enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Sleep. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Hang towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Clean toothbrush. Put away. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast and having a hot drink
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bread and cereal. Take out bowl and plate. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Take toast from toaster. Butter toast. Sit at table. Eat cereal and toast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Remove casual clothes. Put on work shirt. Button shirt. Put on work pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open work bag. Place stethoscope, phone, keys, and wallet into bag. Zip bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients on the ward
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at ward. Put bag in locker. Wash hands. Attend handover meeting. Receive patient assignments. Check patient charts. Visit patient 1. Take vitals. Administer medication. Update records. Visit patient 2. Change dressing. Assist with mobility. Respond to call bell. Take break. Eat lunch. Return to ward. Continue rounds. Document. Handover to next shift.
Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Lock door. Walk to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and changing into comfortable clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Place clothes in hamper. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around hair. Put on comfortable clothes. Hang towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting on the sofa, watching TV and having a light snack reheated in the microwave to avoid induction-cooker peak tax hours
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open microwave. Place snack inside. Close microwave door. Press buttons. Wait. Open microwave. Take out snack. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker now that the evening peak tax period has ended
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on range hood. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and cleaning up the dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish eating. Stand up. Pick up dishes. Scrape leftovers into bin. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe table. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with the computer and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Open laptop. Turn on TV. Check email. Browse internet. Type on keyboard. Move mouse. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Continue computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine, brushing teeth and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Hang towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Clean toothbrush. Put away. Turn off light.
Walk into bedroom. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Sleep.
